connect.title: Ku xir telefoonkan
connect.sub: Geli koodhkan pr.social oo ku jira Qalabka. Telefoonku wuu isku xiri doonaa.
connect.path: pr.social: Qalabka → App-ka daalacashada → geli koodhka.
connect.expired.sub: Koodhku wuxuu shaqeeyaa toban daqiiqo. Hel mid cusub.
connect.fail.network: Xiriir ma jiro pr.social. App-ku wuu isku dayi doonaa koodhka isagoo keliya marka internetku soo laabto.
connect.fail.often: Koodhar badan ayaa laga codsaday shabakaan. Isku day {min} daqiiqo kadib.
connect.fail.busy: pr.social waa mashquul. Isku day daqiiqad kadib.
connect.fail.other: pr.social ma jawaabin. Isku day mar kale.
connect.done.title: Waa la ku xiray
connect.done: Telefoonkan hadda waxa uu ku xiran yahay akoonka @{user}.
connect.off.sub: Akoonkaaga pr.social ayaa laga saaray. Si aad mar kale ugu xirto, isticmaal koodhka cusub ee hoose.
connect.no.tasks: Si telefoonku u xirmo, waxaad u baahan tahay ugu yaraan {need} hawl oo la ansixiyay. Hawlaha ku dhammee pr.social, kadibna geli koodhkan mar kale.
connect.no.devices: Akoonkaaga horey ayaa ku xiran {max} aalad. Mid ka jar pr.social Qalabka, kadibna geli koodhkan mar kale.
connect.no.device: Telefoonkan lama xiri karo. App-ka ka rakib kaliya pr.social: emulators iyo telefoonada root-ka leh lama taageero.
connect.no.restricted: Akoonkaaga waa xaddidan. Telefoonka waa la xiri karaa marka xaddidaadda la qaado.
connect.no.off: App-ka daalacashada wali ma diyaar u yahay akoonkaaga.
stats.title: Tirakoobka
limits.title: Xaddidaadyo
limits.hour.hint: Intee sayt ayuu telefoonkanu muujin karaa saacad kasta
limits.day.hint: Intee sayt ayuu akoonkaagu muujin karaa maalin kasta, dhammaan aaladaha wadajir
home.week.bars: Kasbashada telefoonkan 7-ka maalmood ee u dambeeyay
home.ready: Websites waa iska furmaan, mid ka dambeeya mid, intii app-ku shaashadda ku furan yahay. Shaashaddu ma demayso, laakiin way iftiin yaraanaysaa.
home.notready: Muujintu way bilaaban doontaa marka tan la saxo
home.need.wifi: Ku xir Wi-Fi ama oggolow internetka mobiilka
home.need.internet: Internet ma jiro: ku xir Wi-Fi ama internetka mobiilka
home.need.charger: Ku xir korontada ama oggolow muujinta batariga
home.need.battery: Korontada ku xir: batariga wuxuu ka hooseeyaa 20 %
home.need.cool: Telefoonku aad buu u kulaatay: muujintu way bilaabmi doontaa marka uu qaboojo
home.journal.hint: Saxaafad kasta oo la muujiyay iyo natiijadeeda
home.choice.battery: marka la xiro iyo batariga sidoo kale
home.update.hint: Waxay ku rakibmi doontaa nooca hadda jira qiyaastii hal daqiiqo gudahood. Akoonkaaga iyo dakhligaaga way ilaalin doonaan.
home.update.allow: Android waxay u baahan tahay ogolaansho si ay app-yada uga rakibto PR Surf. Oggolow oo soo noqo: rakibuhu wuu furmi doonaa si toos ah.
home.update.failed.network: Soo dejintu way go'day. Hubi internetka oo mar kale isku day.
home.update.failed.space: Xasuusta telefoonka ma ku filna. Meel bannaan samee oo mar kale isku day.
home.update.failed.site: Cusbooneysiinta lama soo dejin karin. Dhowr daqiiqo kadib mar kale isku day.
gate.blocked.sub: PR.SOCIAL ayaa xannibay telefoonkan. Caawimaadda u qor si aad u ogaato sababta iyo waxa aad sameyso.
gate.restricted.sub: Inta xaddidaadda socota, daalacashada waa la joojiyay. Caawimaadda ayaa sababta kuu sharxi karta.
gate.update.sub: Nooca hadda ma shaqeeyo. Kan cusub wuxuu ku rakibmi doonaa qiyaastii hal daqiiqo, akoonkaaga iyo dakhligaaguna way ilaalin doonaan.
gate.closed.sub: App-ku wuu hubiyaa taas isagoo keliya. Waxba ma sameyn baahnid. Marka daalacashada mar kale diyaar noqoto, badhanka bilowga ayaa soo noqon doona.
fix.vpn.sub: Dalabyada qaarkood waxay tirinayaan kaliya booqdayaasha aan VPN isticmaalin. Ka dhig VPN-ka si aad saxaafad badan u hesho.
wait.empty.sub: Saxaafad cusub ayaa soo muuqda marka xayeysiiyayaashu booqasho dalbadaan. Hubinta xigta waa {time}. App-ka ha xirin.
wait.hour.sub: Muujintu si toos ah ayay u sii socon doontaa {time}.
wait.day.sub: Muujintu si toos ah ayay u sii socon doontaa {time}.
wait.busy.sub: Muujintu waxay sii socon doontaa {time}. Saxaafadihii hore ee la muujiyay lama lumin doono.
wait.network.sub: Isku daygii xigta waa {time}. Saxaafadihii hore ee la muujiyay lama lumin doono.
pause.screen.sub: Muujintu way sii socon doontaa markaad app-ka dib ugu noqoto.
pause.person.sub: Riix Sii wad marka aad diyaar tahay.
pause.no_wifi.sub: Saxaafadaha waxaa la muujiyaa Wi-Fi keliya. Ku xir Wi-Fi ama oggolow internetka mobiilka.
pause.no_charger.sub: Saxaafadaha waxaa la muujiyaa intuu telefoonku korontada ku xiran yahay oo kaliya.
pause.low_battery.sub: Ku xir korontada, muujintuna way sii socon doontaa si toos ah.
pause.hot.sub: Bandhigga wuu sii socon doonaa markii telefoonku qaboojo.
pause.no_internet.sub: Bandhigga wuu sii socon doonaa markii xiriirku soo noqdo.
pause.check_missed.sub: Waqtigii la siiyay looma jawaabin “Ma halkaan baad joogtaa?”. Taabo “Sii wad” si aad dib ugu bilowdo.
check.title: Ma halkaan baad joogtaa?
check.sub: Taabo badhanka hoose si aad u sii waddo. Ilaa aad jawaab bixin, daalacashadu waa hakad.
stop.ask.sub: Baararka hore ee la muujiyay ayaa weli la tiri doonaa.
journal.title: Taariikh
journal.empty.title: Weli wax ma jiraan
journal.empty: Boggan waxaa ka muuqan doona baararka uu app-ku muujiyo, mid kastaana wuxuu tilmaamayaa in la tiriyay iyo in aanu la tirin.
why.LOAD: Baarku ma furmin. Tani waa dhibaatada baarka, ma aha mid kaaga.
why.DNS: Cinwaanka baarka ma shaqeeyo mar dambe. Ma jiro wax aad sameyso.
why.TIMEOUT: Baarku waqti dheer ayuu ku soo rarayay. Waxay noqon kartaa mid gaabis ah ama xiriirku uu daciif yahay: Wi-Fi ayaa badanaa caawiya.
why.HTTP: Baarku khalad ayuu soo celiyay. Ma jiro wax aad sameyso.
why.SSL: Shahaadada amniga ee baarku ma aha mid sax ah, sidaas darteed app-ku ma furin.
why.BLOCKED: Ilaalinta baarka ayaa app-ka uga mamnuucday inuu bogga furo.
why.VIDEO: Fiidiyowga ma bilowdo: waxaa laga yaabaa in la tirtiray ama la qariyay.
why.CRASH: Browser-ka app-ka ayaa bogan dhex joojay oo dib u bilowday.
why.EARLY: App-ku wuxuu baarkan wax ka sheegay ka hor waqtiga muujinta. Hubi in taariikhda iyo waqtiga telefoonkaaga la dejiyay si toos ah.
why.SHORT: Bogga waxaa shaashadda ku jiray wakhti gaaban. Ka dhig app-ka oo furan iyo shaashadda oo shidan.
why.VIDEO_SHORT: Fiidiyowga wakhti dheer uma socon: xayaysiis ama hakad ayaa waqtiga qaaday.
why.CONTROL: Tani waxay ahayd bogga hubinta pr.social, oo si sax ah looma muujin.
why.NOT_SHOWN: Muujinta ayaa joogsatay ka hor intaanu baarkan gaarin.
why.RESTRICTED: Akoonkaaga waa xaddidan yahay: baarku ma tirin doono ilaa xaddidaadda laga qaado.
why.GONE: App-ku wuxuu baarkan wax ka sheegay wakhti dambeeyay: wuxuu xidhnaa wakhti dheer.
settings.title: Dejinta
settings.wifi.hint: Baararka iyo fiidiyowga ma isticmaali doonaan internetka mobilka
settings.charging.hint: Shaashaddu ma damayso, sidaas darteed batteriga ayaa kaydinaya.
settings.dim.hint: Daqiiqad ka dib taabashadii ugu dambeysay, shaashaddu waa hoos u dhacdaa, muujintuna way sii socotaa
settings.disconnect.ask: Telefoonku ma xirnaan doono @{user} mar dambe. Mar kale waxaad ku xiri kartaa koodh cusub.
toast.busy: pr.social hadda waa mashquul. Mar kale isku day daqiiqad ka dib.
toast.mobile: Internetka mobilka waa la oggol yahay. Tan waad ka beddeli kartaa dejinta.
toast.nocharger: Muujinta waxaa hadda lagu oggolaanayaa batteriga sidoo kale. Tan waad ka beddeli kartaa dejinta.
toast.nobrowser: Browser lama helin si loo furo pr.social
toast.noupdate: Nooca cusub weli ma diyaar aha. Mar dambe isku day.
toast.ok.again: Waa wanaagsan tahay: waad bilaabi kartaa
toast.still.update: App-ka weli waa in la cusbooneysiiyo
settings.mini.hint: Markaad ka baxdo app-ka, websaydhyada ayaa sii socon doona daaqada yar oo ku dul sabaysa app-yada kale
settings.mini.denied: Picture-in-picture waa la damiyay PR Surf dejinta telefoonka
home.mini: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa app-yada kale, websaydhyada ayaa wali sii socon doona daaqada yar.
show.resumed: Daalacashada waxay sii socotay meeshii ay ka joogsatay
notify.stopped.sub: Taabo si aad u sii wadato: websaydhyada ayaa ka sii socon doona meeshii ay ka joogsadeen.
skip.title: Ma ka gudubtaa goobtan?
skip.sub: Ma tirinayo, mana kuu soo bixi doono mar kale.
skip.done: Waa la gudbiyay. Goobta xigta ayaa furmaysa.
